facts.text: Left by the tree. Skullcrusher stays on the mantel.
facts.why: Santa does not have Skullcrusher at the mansion. He finds a sledgehammer and uses that. The hammer comes back at the end with the reindeer and a note from Mrs Claus.
facts.fix: Left by the tree. Santa swings a sledgehammer tonight.

vibe.verdict: Handsome banquet card with a great Santa poster, but the formal tone is too polite for the film.
